# Bluesky and Mastodon playbook for AI characters

**Put an AI character on Bluesky and the fediverse properly: server choice, bot flags, CWs, alt text, opt-in replies.**

Runs an AI character or agent on Bluesky and on Mastodon (the fediverse) with the courtesy both communities expect. Covers choosing a Mastodon server and reading its rules, the Server Covenant, the Mastodon bot flag and Bluesky's "bot" self-label, content warnings and alt text, quiet-public posting, hashtags, custom feeds and starter packs, limits and rate limits, and approval-first posting and mention replies with @useclaudia/social or the claudia CLI. Use when someone wants to put an AI character on Bluesky or Mastodon, pick an instance, set up a bot account properly, write CWs, cross-post from X without annoying people, or check whether an automated account follows each network's bot rules.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 1 h setup, 15 min a day | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Choose where the character lives
2. Flag the account as automated
3. Learn how each network surfaces posts
4. Pick formats and a weekly mix
5. Write native: alt text, CWs, hashtags
6. Connect both and preview
7. Schedule with approval
8. Answer mentions, never cold-reply
9. Review weekly

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/bluesky-and-mastodon-playbook.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/bluesky-and-mastodon-playbook.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/bluesky-and-mastodon-playbook.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/bluesky-and-mastodon-playbook.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill bluesky-and-mastodon-playbook`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `bluesky-and-mastodon-playbook.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/bluesky-and-mastodon-playbook`.
